title: Time bound for the marker-existence test
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$, the marker-existence scanner computes the one-bit word whose bit is true exactly when $x$ contains a true bit, within $|x|+1$ steps.
replaced:
For every $n$ and every input of length $n$, the marker-existence scanner
halts within $n+1$ steps, and its output is the single bit recording whether
the input contains a $1$ bit.
